Translation.Jobs.Talents.Active.Bug: Toss up to 15m. Listening device automatically moves up to 2m into hiding on the target.
Translation.BlockDesc.XXXX0: I've learned some {10} leaders are attending a secret meeting. Can you <style=DialogTerm>eavesdrop</style> on the meeting for me?
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop.1: Security is tight on this meeting. I'm not even sure where it is being held.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop.2: But I know where one of the {10} leaders will come from.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop.3: If you can plant a listening device on them before the get to the meeting, you'll be able to hear what is going on.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop.4: It will be tricky - you can't let them know what you have done.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop.5: Stealth will be critical, at least until you plant the device.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop.6: A stealth job. We'll look at the plan and consider it.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop.7_Male: {1} has offered a <style=DialogTerm>Eavesdrop</style> job. We need to throw a camouflaged listening device onto a VIP without alerting the bodyguards.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop.7_Female: {1} has offered a <style=DialogTerm>Eavesdrop</style> job. We need to throw a camouflaged listening device onto a VIP without alerting the bodyguards.
Translation.M_PGen_Eavesdrop.MissionDesc.1.Male: {1} wants to eavesdrop a secret meeting. We need to plant a listening device on one of the {10} attendees.
Translation.M_PGen_Eavesdrop.MissionDesc.1.Female: {1} wants to eavesdrop a secret meeting. We need to plant a listening device on one of the {10} attendees.
Translation.M_PGen_Eavesdrop.RoomDesc: We need to plant a listening device on the VIP without alerting them.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Intro.2: The VIP will arrive soon on their way to the meeting. We need to be in place to plant the listening device.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Intro.3: Modern listening devices look like the 'bugs' that they are sometimes called. They can crawl into a hiding place on their own.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Intro.4: All we have to do is get close enough to throw the listening device at them. The device will home in and plant itself on the clothing. We can then listen to the secret meeting.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Intro.5: The tricky part is we can't let the VIP or bodyguards see us doing it.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Intro.6: If they become alerted to our presence too soon, they will be on the lookout. They would notice the listening device as it lands on the VIP.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Intro.7: That would make this a total waste. We'd never get a second chance.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Intro.8: If the bodyguards are alerted before we plant the listening device, we may as well go home.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Intro.9: After the listening device is planted, it won't matter if they see us. The device will be well camouflaged and they won't know why we are here.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Intro.10: But if a fight starts, don't kill the VIP! We need them to arrive at their meeting.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Intro.11: We must plant the listening device stealthily. The device can be thrown up to 15m and will guide itself to the target if it lands within 2m. If the VIP or guards become Alerted before we plant the device, we fail the mission. If fighting breaks out, we must avoid killing the VIP. Death of the VIP will cause mission defeat.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Arrival2.1: The asset is on the ground!
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Arrival2.3: We need to get close enough to throw the listening device at the VIP.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Arrival2.4: We don't have much time and we need to avoid being spotted. If the VIP or bodyguards see us before we plant the device, this mission is over.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_RevealExit.1: I've got the VIP's exit route pinned down -
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_RevealExit2.1: They are headed to this exit.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_RevealExit2.2: If the VIP enters this zone, we will immediately lose the mission.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Spotted.1: They've spotted us! Head to the exit. We have no hope of planting the listening device when they are alerted.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Escaped.1: The target has reached their secure zone - break off the chase!
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_KilledVIP.2: Everyone retreat, this mission is lost!
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Done.1: Good throw! The listening device is crawling into the clothing and hiding itself.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Done.2: Head to the exit. Let's get out of here.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Exit.1_Male: Time to listen in and let {1} know what the meeting is about.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Exit.1_Female: Time to listen in and let {1} know what the meeting is about.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Victory.1: The listening device has been planted, and we heard the whole meeting with the VIP none the wiser.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_Defeat.1: Someone spotted us and blew the whole mission. We didn't get a chance to plant the listening device.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_DeadDefeat.2: We got involved in a fight, and the VIP went down in the crossfire.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Eavesdrop_DeadDefeat.3: That's not what I paid you to do!
